package rulefixtures

import (
	"sync"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_lazy_loading_lazy_once_hides_slow_first_request: Layer: Lazy loading. Flag sync.Once lazy initialization on request paths without warmup or latency accounting.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
var (
	heavyResource interface{}
	initOnce      sync.Once
)

func scenario558Positive(key string) interface{} {
	// sync.Once defers all the expensive initialization to the first
	// request that calls this function. That first caller experiences
	// high latency without any warning or readiness-gate provision.
	initOnce.Do(func() {
		heavyResource = initializeHeavy558()
	})
	return heavyResource
}

func initializeHeavy558() interface{} {
	return "expensive-init-result"
}
